desc: The only active generation settings: this is the default for --preset at every entry point across the whole pipeline. The client section is the temperature-1 collection settings (api harmony / reasoning_effort high / temperature 1.0 / top_p 1.0 / max_tokens 8192 / Current date 2026-08-06); the nyapass batch (collection run_id nyapass) collects from this preset. seed stays null; reproducing at temperature 1.0 is handled by the collector's --seeds, dispatched per trajectory (seed family 42/67/4267/6742) -- the preset itself governs the seed-independent shared settings. The server section is copied from the nyapass batch's server launcher envs/runs/nyapass/launch_servers.py (tokyo108:8103 replica A, GPU memory 0.92, max_model_len follows vLLM's factory default); serve_preset.py uses it to assemble the vllm serve command
